description: Use this when a student wants a real practice question for an English exam task, for example "give me a PTE Write Essay prompt" or "a TOEFL listening question". Returns one random published question (prompt, passage, options, word limit, and an audio link for listening tasks) and a link where the student can answer it with the real timer and scoring. It never returns answers or model responses. Do not use it to check an answer; it only serves questions. For PTE Read Aloud or Describe Image, use speak_practice instead: it serves the question with a recorder so the student can answer and be scored in the chat.

taskType.description: Task-type slug, e.g. "write-essay" or "listening-mcq-single". Call exam_overview to list the valid slugs.
